crossRefs.note: He was a mighty hunter before Yahweh. Therefore it is said, “like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before Yahweh”.
The boys grew. Esau was a skillful hunter, a man of the field. Jacob was a quiet man, living in tents.
Now Isaac loved Esau, because he ate his venison. Rebekah loved Jacob.

translations.web: Now therefore, please take your weapons, your quiver and your bow, and go out to the field, and get me venison.
translations.bsb: Take your weapons—your quiver and bow—and go out into the field to hunt some game for me.
translations.kjv: Now therefore take, I pray thee, thy weapons, thy quiver and thy bow, and go out to the field, and take me some venison;
translations.asv: Now therefore take, I pray thee, thy weapons, thy quiver and thy bow, and go out to the field, and take me venison.
